This notebook accompanies Isaac Daroch’s portfolio. It separates **research interests**, **educational demonstrations**, **publication records** and **long-term ambitions**.

## Start with the distinction

The state of a world and the representation used by an agent need not agree. The portfolio’s local experiment makes that distinction visible without pretending to train a world model.

- [Two maps: world and representation](notes/two-maps.qmd).
- [Protocol: what the gridworld actually does](notes/demo-protocol.qmd).
- [Deterministic replay and two distinct comparisons](notes/episode-replay.qmd).
- [What reproducibility does—and does not—establish](notes/reproducibility.qmd).

[Open the interactive laboratory](https://isaac-daroch.github.io/projects/#agent-lab) or [return to the portfolio](https://isaac-daroch.github.io/).

## Publication sources

The portfolio separately records the clinical NL-to-SQL publication @daroch2026-governed. Its bibliographic information is generated from the same catalog used by the portfolio. These notes do not re-audit that study and the gridworld is not an experiment from it.

## Reading without extra services

Equations are emitted as MathML; this notebook does not depend on a remote inference service. Code samples below are explanatory and are not executed on a visitor’s device unless the visitor runs them independently.
